svg.title: Reliability for Agent Memory: Provenance, Forgetting, and Trust Audits
svg.desc: Poster, 36 by 24 inch landscape, conference template header. Left: the headline that deleting the weakest link makes the chain stronger, a before and after provenance chain, the min of an empty set, a 24 percent simulation result and a guess-the-confidence interaction. Right: a conformance table of four properties across three forget modes, a bar chart, limitations, open questions and a QR code to the repository.

text.font-family: Georgia, Cambria, Times New Roman, serif
Georgia, Cambria, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Forgetting the evidence strengthened the conclusion — and nothing in the store said so.
the minimum over an empty chain imposes no bound — same test, one configuration flag

text.font-family: Georgia, Cambria, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: of writes declared at 0.9 or above, in a sixty-round
three-agent simulated run, rested on one 0.40 guess.
Effective confidence was computed on every one.
A reader that honours the number perfectly gets that to 4%. A gate gets it to zero.
Weakest link, average, or product? Put a dot on your answer — then ask me why.
git clone → make reproduce → the same numbers, byte for byte, on any machine. No model in the measurement path.
26 EXECUTABLE CHECKS · SAME TEST, ONE FLAG
every memory back to its roots
one signed comparison, no branch on mode; the divergence comes from the declaration
HOW FAR ONE BAD MEMORY TRAVELS
writes declared ≥ 0.9 whose effective confidence ≤ 0.5 · 60 rounds · seed 7
gated is zero by construction at τ = 0.5: nothing bounded at 0.40 can be cited.
surfaced is an upper bound — a policy that honours the number every time.
• Make an agent act on the number — enforce at a gate
• Detect an undeclared source — a trust layer, not a truth layer
• Judge conflicts — a judgment is a record, not an edge
• Measure retrieval quality — orthogonal to LoCoMo, LongMemEval, BEAM
Is a tombstone compatible with a deletion obligation?
Should min over an empty chain be 1.0, 0.0, or a refusal to answer?
Could a forget leave only a bound, with no record and no explanation?
